note_manual: all crops are rendered at 400 dpi (tool default = 300 dpi): 9 of the 11 figures are vector plots (line art in the style of gnuplot output) whose 0.3 pt curves and dash patterns separate better at 400 dpi, and the two embedded rasters (Fig. 2, Fig. 7) are 200 dpi, so 400 dpi is an exact 2× enlargement. Numbers quoted in mpm_note_ko as [판독 · 벡터 경로] were read from the path coordinates of the PDF drawing operators (frame and tick positions give the axis mapping), not from pixels; the read-out (27 curves sampled every 0.01 strain + 49 summary values) is stored next to the crops as digitized.csv.
